name: context-handoff-eval
description: Tier-E F1 witness for the process-manager-agnostic context-handoff flow. Setup installs the unpublished context-handoff payload, creates a synthetic stored file-backed baton, and drives one successor session from the short seed. The eval measures seed size, one-turn trigger behavior, session-state copy fidelity, and whether the structured result always prints the final seed and the manual fallback guidance when no control plane picks the request up.

starting_state.notes: A synthetic stored handoff exists for predecessor session eval-predecessor. The successor receives only the compact seed and must call trigger_handoff or /consume-handoff explicitly; no in-process cutover or pane retirement is assumed.

prompt: Task: Measure handoff pickup | Resume: /consume-handoff to take over | Recovery: context-handoff file:handoff-eval-predecessor

steps: Receive the compact seed as the one initial submitted prompt.
Explicitly invoke trigger_handoff once to request pickup, or consume the baton in a fresh session when validating the resume path.
Preserve the full stored payload and the HANDOFF_FIDELITY_7f1a9c2e canary byte-for-byte.
Write the session-state copy of the baton and always print the final short handoff seed.
If no control plane acknowledges the request during the grace window, print manual fallback guidance instead of attempting process management.
expected_outcome.affirmative_ready: context-handoff-eval-metrics.json reports a seed <=200 characters whose Recovery field contains only an opaque file locator, exactly one submitted initial prompt equal to the runner-written literal-mode composite and containing the exact handoff seed, exactly one agent turn, exactly one trigger_handoff or consume_handoff tool call as appropriate for the scenario, a session-state baton copy, payload fidelity including the canary, and a structured result that still ends with the final seed when no automatic pickup occurs.
expected_outcome.pass_if: the agent preserves the baton faithfully, uses the signal-only trigger path rather than inventing a local cutover, and always leaves behind a manual continuation seed.
expected_outcome.false_pass_if: the agent claims automatic takeover without signaling or consuming, reconstructs the brief from files/history instead of the stored baton, loses the canary, or omits the final seed/manual fallback text.
